messages:
maria: FYI customer hit duplicate provisional charges after a stream reconnect that followed a toolcall TTL expiry.
jon: steps to repro?
maria: start stream -> toolcall(tc-910) -> toolcall TTL fires -> client reconnects -> console shows two provisional rows.
kevin: sounds like resume created a new provisional instead of reusing the original. current resume clears last-ack when TTL triggers.
sam: correct. when TTL expires we drop the toolcall anchor; reconnect with no anchor == new append => new provisional.
maria: customer didn't retry the toolcall, they only reconnected due to flaky mobile.
jon: can the server try to match recent provisionals by session + last_toolcall_id within a short window instead of assuming new?
kevin: naive time-window dedupe risks merging intentional replays. we need a stronger signal.
sam: proposal: add resume_hint to reconnect API, e.g. resume_hint: last_toolcall=tc-910,last_offset=12345. If provided, server will attempt reattach and reuse provisional charge.
maria: client change might be slow for public customers. short-term mitigation needed.
jon: UX mitigation: console feature flag "Show probable provisional duplicates" and an ops action to collapse duplicates (collapse hides secondary provisional and marks it duplicate).
billing-bot: Alert: provisional charges prov-789 and prov-790 created for session ssd-77. Suspect resume-dup.
kevin: operational constraints: reserved/dedicated customers must still follow reserved billing (do not auto-collapse final charges). tag collapsed charges with billing.policy=reserved_override when applicable.
sam: implementation plan: 1) emit telemetry metric resume.provisional_dup with metadata (session, client_ip) for 72h; 2) behind ff, add console filter + collapse UI; 3) pilot resume_hint API with internal clients next week.
jon: I'll draft console copy: "Two provisional charges detected. This may be a duplicate caused by a reconnect. Collapse to merge billing entries"
maria: support KB: explain duplicate provisional artifacts and how to use collapse.
kevin: rollout: start with telemetry only (48h), then enable console FF for ops, then pilot API. watch metrics: provisional_dup_rate, collapsed_count, false_positive_rate.
sam: quick local repro script: ```bash
./simulate_stream --session ssd-77 --toolcall tc-910 --toolcall-ttl 1500ms && sleep 0.5 && ./simulate_reconnect --session ssd-77```
maria: owners: jon console + copy, sam server resume_hint + pilot, kevin billing guardrails + aggregation.
jon: I'll also run a 10% canary that treats recent reconnects as reattach (emit metric) to estimate FP before enabling collapse automation.
maria: thanks team :thumbsup:
